title.en: Fable 20 — The Crow and the Pitcher

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: היה קיץ חם מאוד באותה שנה.
sentences.en: It was a very hot summer that year.

sentences.ar: הנהרות היו יבשים, ולא היו מים.
sentences.en: The rivers were dry, and there was no water.

sentences.ar: עורב עף שעות וחיפש משהו לשתות.
sentences.en: A crow flew for hours and looked for something to drink.
He was very tired and thirsty.

sentences.ar: ואז הוא ראה כד ליד בית.
sentences.en: And then he saw a jar beside a house.
He came down fast and stood on it.
Inside the jar there was little water.

sentences.ar: הוא הכניס את הראש ולא הגיע.
sentences.en: He put his head in and did not reach.

sentences.ar: הצוואר של הכד היה צר וארוך.
sentences.en: The neck of the jar was narrow and long.
He tried to knock the jar over.
The jar was heavy and did not move.
He sat beside it and thought a moment.
And then he saw small stones.

sentences.ar: הוא לקח אבן והכניס אותה פנימה.
sentences.en: He took a stone and put it inside.

sentences.ar: הוא לקח עוד אבן, ועוד אחת.
sentences.en: He took another stone, and one more.
He worked like that a long time.
In the end the water reached the top.

sentences.ar: הוא שתה, ואז עף לו בשמחה.
sentences.en: He drank, and then flew off happily.
